story.title: Switch between communities
story.text: As a community manager, I want to switch between my communities from one login and see only the selected community’s requests, so that I never answer a resident with another community’s information.
acs: Given M1 manages Mountain Ridge and Pine Hollow and each has one Open request, When M1 selects Pine Hollow, Then the request list shows only the Pine Hollow request.
Given M2 manages only Elm Court, When M2 opens the community selector, Then only Elm Court is offered.

mapping_limitation: Legacy community assignment and switching slice; current S-3 AC-11/12 only; invitation administration excluded
assumption: We assume a management company allows one manager login to see every community that manager is assigned to.
